title: Hardware-Aware Fermion-to-Qubit Mappings for Simulating the 2D Hubbard Model on Heavy-Hexagon Quantum Processors
summary: Quantum simulation of strongly correlated fermionic systems is among the most promising near- term applications of quantum computing, but its practical efficiency depends critically on the choice of fermion-to-qubit mapping and on the connectivity of the underlying hardware. In this work we address this problem in the context of the two-dimensional Hubbard model, simulated on IBM superconducting quantum processors with heavy-hexagon connectivity.
